help.text:
Finish measuring
Press Esc/Enter or click the last point again to finish measuring.

Draw freehand
Hold down Shift to draw freehand. This works when you draw lines or areas.

Turn off snapping
Hold down the Space bar to temporarily turn off snapping.

Perpendicular measuring
Hold down Ctrl on Windows or Cmd (⌘) on Mac and click a line to measure perpendicular to that line. Note: the line you click must be a vector line that you snap to.
